description.value: JX Campground and Surf Shop is a campground, surf rental, and e-bike rental hub sitting on the Tofino-Ucluelet Highway on Vancouver Island's rugged west coast. The property hosts T-Bird E-bike Rentals for exploring the surrounding Yuułuʔiłʔatḥ First Nation territory, alongside tent and RV campsites and multiple on-site food trucks. It offers a convenient overnight and resupply stop for touring cyclists riding the Pacific Rim corridor.

raw_osm.name: JX Surf Shop by Relic
raw_osm.note: Hours are for summer only. Call for hours other times.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at uclueletcamping.com confirms this is JX Campground and Surf Shop at 2695 Tofino-Ucluelet Hwy, Ucluelet, BC — matching the OSM housenumber 2695. The site prominently features 'T-Bird E-bike Rentals' as an on-site service, confirming e-bike rentals, and lists outhouses and potable water for all camping options. No evidence of traditional bike repair services, pumps, or mechanical assistance appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name 'JX Surf Shop by Relic' differs from website name 'JX Campground and Surf Shop'; website footer also references 'JX by Relic Surf Shop', suggesting overlapping branding between JX and the separate Relic Surf Shop.
URL (uclueletcamping.com) was auto-discovered at medium confidence and is not present in OSM tags directly.
OSM has no phone number; (250)-266-0408 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
Categorized as Bike Services via shop=sports but the primary business is a campground and surf shop; e-bike rentals are a sub-brand (T-Bird) rather than core cycle services.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible business on Vancouver Island's west coast with e-bike rentals, camping, and food services — a useful stop for touring cyclists on the Tofino-Ucluelet corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: T-Bird E-bike Rentals appears to be a distinct sub-brand operating within the JX Campground property. A second related location, Relic Surf Shop in Ucluelet, is referenced on the surf rentals page with separate contact details (info@relicsurfshop.com, 250-726-4421) and may warrant its own OSM record check.
